title: Coral Carbohydrate Assay for 96-well plates
author: Colleen B Bove
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bvb9n2r6

steps.title: Thaw coral slurries
steps.instruction: Retrieve the desired coral slurry tubes from the –80 °C freezer and allow them to thaw at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare labeled tubes
steps.instruction: Collect the required number of test tubes (10 for the standards plus one for each sample) and label each tube accordingly.

steps.title: Dilute coral samples
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of each thawed coral slurry to its pre‑labelled test tube and add 900 µL of Milli‑Q water (adjust dilution if necessary based on sample collection).

steps.title: Make standards and blank
steps.instruction:
Prepare the carbohydrate standards and blank as follows (volumes are in µL):

Tube ID | Concentration (mg/mL) | Vol water | Vol 1 mM Glucose | Vol 10 mM Glucose
--- | --- | --- | --- | ---
B0 | 0.0000 | 1000 | 0 | 0
B1 | 0.0090 | 190 | 195 | 0
B2 | 0.0180 | 290 | 100 | 0
B3 | 0.0270 | 385 | 150 | 0
B4 | 0.0360 | 480 | 200 | 0
B5 | 0.0540 | 670 | 300 | 0
B6 | 0.0901 | 500 | 500 | 0
B7 | 0.1802 | 1000 | 800 | 0
B8 | 0.3604 | 800 | 1000 | 0
B9 | 0.9015 | 500 | 2000 | 0
(Blank contains only water; adjust volumes as shown for each concentration.)

steps.title: Vortex samples
steps.instruction: Vortex each diluted sample (previously bead‑beaten with glass beads) for a few seconds to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Set up water bath
steps.instruction: Place a rack of test tubes in a room‑temperature water bath inside the fume hood (DI water in a plastic bin is sufficient).

steps.title: Add phenol and acid
steps.instruction: For each tube, perform the following sub‑steps in order:

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µL of phenol to the tube.
Vortex in the hood for 3 seconds.
Immediately add 2.5 mL of sulfuric acid.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Transfer the tube to the room‑temperature water bath.

steps.title: Incubate samples
steps.instruction: After the last tube has been placed in the water bath, incubate all tubes for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer to 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL of each standard and each sample into the bottom of the appropriate wells of a 96‑well plate. Use the provided plate layout for either three‑replicate or four‑replicate format (layouts are given in the original document).

steps.title: Read absorbance
steps.instruction: Cover the plate and measure absorbance at 485 nm with a plate spectrophotometer. Calculate sample carbohydrate concentrations using the standard curve as described in the Materials section.
